{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern U.S. cuisine]] 

A lot of crispy baked chicken recipes use things like breadcrumbs or cracker crumbs. Here, the croûtons add a little flavor.
  
== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (28–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] crushed garlic-flavored [[Cookbook:Crouton|croûtons]]
* ¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¾ cup grated [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterrey Jack cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 425°F.
#Combine butter, seasonings, and salt in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]] or a large wide dish.
#Dip chicken into egg mixture then [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] into croûton crumbs. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
#Coat chicken pieces on olive oil then place on a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. 
#Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the pieces, and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in the oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
#Sprinkle chicken pieces evenly with cheese and bake until cheese is melted. Serve warm.
